profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Qualia | Building Agentic AI & AI Workflows

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Software Engineer for Clear AI, building AI-powered email and document automation.

positions.title: Ecommerce Developer
positions.description:
E-commerce developer specializing in front-end custom development on top of BigCommerce
platform.

• Created reusable components for the frontend applications.
• Built out custom-tailored e-commerce website, altering pre-existing e-commerce website, and complex custom solutions
• Integrated e-commerce with external web services, such as REST, GraphQL APIs
• Built and maintained integrations with SDKs and plug-ups
• Partner closely with Project Manager and Designers to ensure a successful outcome
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript

positions.title: Junior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack developer on C2C web application, including an internal admin tool.

• Modified frontend Applications using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, and JSON
• Designed APIs using REST principles and REST API design standards and protocols
• Constructed SQL tables, stored procedures, services and Controllers using Spring MVC framework to create APIs to implement logic throughout the application
• Created complex front-end application based on RESTful web services supporting both XML and JSON message transformation
• Implemented the user SNS login/sign-up feature with OAuth 2.0 (Google, Apple, Naver, Kakao)
• Built API for admin/consumer to submit requests to create/read/update/delete merchandise
positions.insights: Skills: Java · HTML · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Spring Boot

positions.title: AI Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research assistant developing a new GAN network system.

• Tasked with creating and developing a new deep learning network (GAN) in python using PyTorch framework
• Developed solution ideas for GAN network with given objective and constrains 
• Worked on a research paper that is currently under review for publication in IEEE Neural Networks and Learning Systems entitled “On self-control of GANs”
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Julia (Programming Language) · PyTorch
